blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — Search and rescue operations for a village councilor who fell from his motorized boat while fishing in the waters of Loay, Bohol, continued on Wednesday. Loay Mayor Lahar Ayuban said Barangay Yanangan Kagawad Andes Patayon was reported missing after falling overboard at around 9 a.m. on Tuesday, Nov. 10. Based on the Philippine Coast Guard’s (PCG) assessment, the reported location where Patayon fell was about 1.11kilometers from the lighthouse along Loay Boulevard.
